visualCharacteristics.purpose: promotional image link with an overlaid title, optional deck text and a call to action
visualCharacteristics.typography: title 44/52 white (default); 35/50 uppercase (light, links); deck 18/28 centred

contentPattern.structure: one row of two cells (or two rows of one cell): image | heading, optional deck paragraph(s), CTA link (bold = primary button)

usage: Home page section teasers (Our Company, Careers, Citizenship, Investor Relations); Our Company sub-page teasers; Newsroom Media Resources and Press Contact.
reuseGuidance: Default: the image links to the first CTA link. Omit the deck for a title-only teaser. Light: navy text for light images, all text overlaid. Links: two or more plain links become secondary buttons overlaid on the image; the image itself is not linked.
